desc:
💸 Welcome back to BloxRP! 💰

Set on a fictional island called Blox State, it's a roleplay experience like no other. It is based off a popular game mode from Garry's Mod which is DarkRP, but is moving past and far beyond! 🔥

🎙️ Spatial Voice is enabled.

We have:
✔️ Money Printers!
✔️Tons of Weapons!
✔️ Turrets!
✔️ Paychecks every sunset!
✔️ Passive mode for players who don't want to fight!
✔️ Jobs with careers to climb: Police, Gun Dealer, Chef, Merchant, Banker and more!
✔️ Elections: run for President!
✔️ Laws, wanted stars, arrests and jail!
✔️ Player-run banks with savings and loans!
✔️ Clans!
✔️ Weapons Shops!
✔️ Housing and property raids!
✔️ Props and a full build mode!
✔️ Weapon Inventory!
✔️ Gym, food and hunger!
✔️ Achievements!
✔️Console Support!
✔️ Gamepasses and VIP!

DarkRP
